name: Pet cone Recovery Collar X-Large (35CM)
shortDescription: Give your pet the protection they need during recovery with the Pet Cone Recovery Collar X-Large (35cm) . Designed for large and extra-large dog breeds, this protective recovery collar helps prevent licking, biting, scratching, and chewing of wounds, stitches, hot spots, skin irritations, and surgical sites, allowing injuries to heal safely and effectively.
description: Crafted from durable yet lightweight materials, the collar provides reliable protection while maintaining your pet's comfort. The adjustable fastening system ensures a secure fit around the neck, while the spacious design allows your dog to eat, drink, sleep, and move around with minimal restriction. Ideal for post-operative care, injury management, and skin treatments, this recovery collar is an essential tool for a stress-free healing process. Whether your pet is recovering from surgery or dealing with a skin condition, the X-Large recovery collar offers dependable protection while reducing the risk of infection and re-injury. Key Features X-Large 35cm cone depth for maximum protection Prevents licking, biting, scratching, and chewing of wounds Ideal for large and extra-large dog breeds Adjustable fit for comfort and security Lightweight and durable construction Comfortable for extended wear Easy-to-clean material for improved hygiene Allows normal eating, drinking, and resting Benefits The Pet Cone Recovery Collar helps promote faster healing by preventing pets from accessing wounds and surgical sites. Its adjustable and comfortable design reduces stress during recovery while providing effective protection against further injury. Size: X-Large (35cm) Suitable For: Large and extra-large dog breeds Use: Post-surgery recovery, wound care, skin conditions, hot spots, injury protection, and healing support.
